scope: Targeted real serving-network path; not whole network page coverage

cases.name: 网络 / UI 创建并绑定专属 Serving 网络 / 真实 GPU 推理走直连、解绑删除后恢复管理网络推理
prerequisites: Explicit remote base_url and node_uuid; credentials only in private config
Real online agent with network inventory, host terminal and non-loopback IPv4 management NIC
Selected node serving resolves only to management; no existing explicit serving binding
Every instance on this server's selected node belongs to the run-owned GPU deployment
Run-owned real GPU model deployment and API key; selected node has a unique searchable display name
Server can reach the selected node's serving TLS forwarder on port 19443

crud.Create: UI creates run-owned host_ethernet serving network and attaches selected node
crud.Read: Independent GET plus browser refresh proves fields, attachment and resolved endpoint
crud.Update: UI removes attachment; standalone network field edits not covered here
crud.Delete: UI deletes detached network; detail 404, collection absence and node baseline restored

checklist_items.1: PARTIAL: create/attach/detach/delete with exact request and refresh
checklist_items.8: PARTIAL: human-readable searchable node selector, keyboard selection and persisted binding
checklist_items.12: PARTIAL: named dialogs, viewport and visible confirmation actions
checklist_items.14.8: Runtime prerequisite: runner owns real GPU deployment; this case does not claim UI deployment creation
checklist_items.20.2: Public gateway non-stream chat confirms real generation on baseline/direct/restored paths

runtime.scope: Single real GPU node; direct serving uses the same physical NIC as management, but replaces its agent tunnel path
assertions: Host ip inventory contains the authoritative management NIC/address
Baseline real chat succeeds with management serving only
UI binding resolves serving uniquely to this run's network and attachment IDs
Real chat succeeds and serving_forward.address equals selected IP:19443, mode=direct, reason empty
UI detach and delete restore management networks exactly and remove serving_forward
The same model again returns real chat text and usage after restoration
runtime.failure_injection: Not covered: no shared-node firewall or interface disruption is performed

cases.cleanup: Case removes only its network through UI. Runner separately owns deployment/API key cleanup; failure keeps scoped resource IDs for diagnosis.
missing: Failure injection proving unreachable dedicated network rejects instead of falling back
Cross-node communication, storage-sync transfer, NCCL/RDMA or bandwidth
Concurrent existing workloads on this server's selected node
